notes.zh: 修复手机 / PWA 窄屏下导入照片后顶部工具栏（全选、全不选、对比、撤销/重做、重置）一行排不下、右侧按钮被裁掉的问题，现在一行完整显示、极窄屏可横向滑动；手机端隐藏桌面级 A/B 对比槽并使用触摸短文案，修正整行向右偏移数像素的问题；同步三端内核（build 18）。
notes.en: Fixed the phone/PWA top toolbar (Select all / None / Compare / Undo / Redo / Reset) overflowing and being clipped on narrow screens — it now fits on one row (horizontal scroll on very narrow screens); hid desktop-only A/B slots on phones with compact touch labels and fixed a few-px rightward shift of the whole row; core synced across all platforms (build 18).
